breakpoints.note: The PoC was parsed as a FLAC stream through frame sync, a valid frame header, and an LPC subframe, and entered partitioned-Rice residual parsing (the first rice_parameter read). This is the parser-admission point on the path to the annotated source/root-cause/sink chain; it is earlier than the sink and later than raw program entry.

FLAC bitreader input-load point: untrusted stream bytes delivered by the decoder read callback are read into the bitreader buffer (target = br->buffer + br->words). This fills br->buffer, the array that is later over-read at the sink.

In the process_tail loop of the Rice residual decoder, `b = br->buffer[cwords]` is read with no check that cwords < br->capacity. The loop re-enters whenever cwords >= br->words and val < end, so with crafted residual coding cwords keeps advancing past br->words up to br->capacity (2048 words); indexing br->buffer at capacity reads 0 bytes past the 8192-byte buffer. The fix adds exactly this guard: `b = cwords < br->capacity ? br->buffer[cwords] << br->consumed_bits : 0;`.
